{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:30.800

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = It had to do with Osiris's dick.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:33.399
    | text      = That's right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:35.160

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:37.360

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = It makes the most sense.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:00.720
    | text      = Yeah, so we were learning a lot about Egypt
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:02.959
    | text      = and Egyptian gods and dicks.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:06.519
    | text      = And so we turn on part five, lecture number five.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:10.279
    | text      = And I feel like we've made a little bit of a departure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:13.639
    | text      = And now we're just talking about the New World Order.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:15.800
    | text      = Sounds right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:16.959
    | text      = Why are all of the legacies of the past, the family,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:21.240
    | text      = national borders, the right to practice any chosen religion,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:24.800
    | text      = the right to private property, among other things
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:27.680
    | text      = under such an attack?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:31.120
    | text      = Is it possible that there are actually
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:32.839
    | text      = people and organizations who really
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:34.360
    | text      = want to change the basic order of things?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:37.399
    | text      = Well, my regular listeners know the answer to that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:41.560
    | text      = Clues to the answers to these questions, folks, can be gleaned from some comments made by
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:48.160
    | text      = people and organizations that are talking about these wide-ranging changes in the nature
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:53.800
    | text      = of our lifestyle.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:55.600
    | text      = An Associated Press dispatch on July the 26th, 1968, reported this, quote,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:03.800
    | text      = New York Governor Nelson A. Rockefeller says as president he would work toward international
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:08.959
    | text      = creation of a new world order, unquote.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:13.800
    | text      = And you thought George Bush coined that phrase.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:17.399
    | text      = Surprise, surprise.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:19.199
    | text      = I really feel like I've gotten whiplash from the Egypt stuff to now somewhat relatively
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:25.480
    | text      = current.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:26.480
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:27.480
    | text      = I don't know, man.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:28.480
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:29.480
    | text      = So Bill referred to Nelson Rockefeller as the governor of New York because he's reading
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:32.120
    | text      = from an AP article from 1968, but it's strange that he doesn't point out that Rockefeller
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:36.159
    | text      = went on to be Gerald Ford's vice president.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:38.840
    | text      = I found this article, and it's real.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:41.440
    | text      = Rockefeller was running for the Republican nomination, and he was advancing a position
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:44.840
    | text      = that was based on increasing dialogue with other countries in order to avoid war with
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:49.080
    | text      = China and the Soviet Union.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:51.000
    | text      = He said, quote, We have no need to be mesmerized by our perils.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:55.039
    | text      = The possibility to build the new order we all seek is limited only by our imagination
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:59.559
    | text      = and dedication.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:01.200
    | text      = Bill knows that Rockefeller wasn't talking about some kind of Illuminati Egypt cult that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:04.919
    | text      = he was working for, whatever the fuck.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:07.399
    | text      = Interestingly, looking through some of these old newspapers, I was able to find a lot of
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:11.919
    | text      = mentions of the new world order previous to 1968 because, of course, Rockefeller didn't
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:16.559
    | text      = coin this term, and neither did Bush.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:18.320
    | text      = Nobody did.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:19.320
    | text      = A lot of them were in letters to the editor, and I bring this up to say that at one point
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:23.740
    | text      = they would print your address in the paper if you wanted to get your opinion published.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:27.419
    | text      = That's how it worked.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:28.419
    | text      = If you were going to talk some crazy shit and you wanted it to be spread widely, you
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:31.940
    | text      = had to be ready to stand behind that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:33.539
    | text      = There you go.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:34.539
    | text      = There you go.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:35.539
    | text      = I thought that was pretty wild to think about.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:37.620
    | text      = There is a measure of quality control that maybe there are better ways to get there,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:43.600
    | text      = but that is a way to get there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:45.379
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:46.379
    | text      = You're taking on a risk by having your address posted, which means that only the people who
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:51.299
    | text      = really believe what they say or people who are recklessly and dangerously crazy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:56.659
    | text      = Absolutely insane.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:57.659
    | text      = Yeah, yeah, yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:58.659
    | text      = Talk shit, get hit is not supposed to be a newspaper's editorial section, but hey, what
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:02.820
    | text      = are you going to do?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:04.820
    | text      = Well?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:05.820
    | text      = Bill has this Nelson Rockefeller quote, and he goes on.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:09.220
    | text      = There's more people who have said new world order before.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:11.500
    | text      = On January the 30th, 1976, a new document called the Declaration of Interdependence
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:17.820
    | text      = was introduced to the American people and it was signed by 124 traitors, 32 senators
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:25.700
    | text      = and 92 representatives, altogether 124 traitors in Washington DC.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:31.139
    | text      = And it read in part, quote, two centuries ago, our forefathers brought forth a new nation.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:37.940
    | text      = Now we must join with others to bring forth a new world order.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:42.340
    | text      = Unquote.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:43.340
    | text      = And you thought George Bush coined that phrase.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:46.799
    | text      = I did.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:47.799
    | text      = Surprise, surprise.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:49.080
    | text      = So the title Declaration of Interdependence has been used a ton of times in the past hundred
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:54.000
    | text      = years.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:55.000
    | text      = And in fact, there were two major ones in 1976, most likely because it was the bicentennial
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:59.840
    | text      = celebrating the 200th anniversary of the Declaration of Independence.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:04.120
    | text      = The one that Bill is talking about was written by a history professor from Amherst College
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:08.360
    | text      = named Henry Steele Comager, or at least the preamble was.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:12.480
    | text      = This small excerpt of the preamble is probably all Bill has ever read of this document because
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:17.440
    | text      = it was the part that was picked up by editorials in the National Spotlight, the anti-Semitic
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:22.000
    | text      = rag published by Willis-Carto's Liberty Lobby.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:25.720
    | text      = The Spotlight was an old time white identity publication that probably coincidentally aired
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:30.399
    | text      = a show on the same shortwave station as Bill and the same one Alex would go on to broadcast
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:34.639
    | text      = on, WWCR.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:38.919
    | text      = In the lead up to 1976, everyone was excited about celebrating the bicentennial, and different
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:44.120
    | text      = cities thought that they had the right to be the official event.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:47.399
    | text      = Boston felt like they were the right choice, which Philadelphia didn't agree with, nor
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:51.720
    | text      = did DC.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:53.200
    | text      = The federal government decided that it wouldn't be right to choose a city to the exclusion
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:56.679
    | text      = of another, so each place could do their own big celebration.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:00.279
    | text      = Philadelphia decided that a part of theirs would be the commissioning of this Declaration
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:04.100
    | text      = of Interdependence.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:05.799
    | text      = It had no official government authority and it meant nothing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:08.679
    | text      = It was symbolic and had a lot to do with the feeling that if the world didn't start
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:12.200
    | text      = working together, we were going to destroy ourselves, which is a prevailing attitude
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:16.159
    | text      = they had in the 70s and mid-2020s.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:20.200
    | text      = As part of the celebration, a bunch of members of Congress signed the document, but their
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:23.480
    | text      = signature didn't mean anything in this context, at least not in terms of passing a law or
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:27.820
    | text      = it being considered a binding treaty.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:31.259
    | text      = Literally every member of Congress could sign my autograph book, and that doesn't magically
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:35.039
    | text      = make it a law.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:36.600
    | text      = The spotlight made a big deal out of this and how it was internationalism trying to
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:40.200
    | text      = take over the country.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:41.799
    | text      = If you go back and you look at the response to this declaration, it's almost entirely
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:45.879
    | text      = associated with the spotlight and an editorial written by a guy named George Benson.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:51.720
    | text      = Benson is remembered as the president of Harding University and, more importantly, as a fierce
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:56.639
    | text      = opponent of racial integration.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:59.580
    | text      = Students at his college attempted to express their desire to desegregate, which led to
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:02.919
    | text      = him giving a speech in 1957, which the Arkansas Times described like this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:08.200
    | text      = Quote, citing Washington, D.C. as an example, Benson warned that integration would bring,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:12.759
    | text      = quote, increased destruction to property, increased gonorrhea and syphilis, and increased
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:17.279
    | text      = pregnancies.
}}

    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:21.319
    | text      = I've opened up a can of worms.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:22.319
    | text      = There we go.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:23.319
    | text      = So, um, yeah, I was just, at this point I was like, all right, people said New World
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:27.039
    | text      = Order a bunch.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:28.039
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:29.039
    | text      = I'm, I'm unimpressed.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:30.039
    | text      = The story of Walter Mills maintains that prior to World War I, Colonel Edward Mandel House,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:35.799
    | text      = the major advisor to Woodrow Wilson, the President at the time, had a hidden motive
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:40.559
    | text      = for involving America in the war.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:42.819
    | text      = The historian wrote this, quote, The Colonel's sole justification for preparing such a batch
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:48.339
    | text      = of blood for his countrymen was his hope of establishing a New World Order of peace and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:54.920
    | text      = security.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:55.920
    | text      = Unquote.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:56.920
    | text      = You see how these people fool themselves?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:59.359
    | text      = They always say that the end is peace and security, a world utopia.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:06.119
    | text      = But to get it, they spill more blood than ever has been spilled in history.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:12.440
    | text      = Each time they try to bring about their utopia, the blood runs in the streets.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:18.039
    | text      = They're liars.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:19.039
    | text      = They're hypocrites.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:20.039
    | text      = They're manipulators, deceivers.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:21.039
    | text      = They are the worshippers of Lucifer.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:25.400
    | text      = So by this point in the episode, I was pretty sure that most of this was just Bill reading.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:29.319
    | text      = He was reading stuff.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:30.319
    | text      = He was plagiarizing again.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:31.319
    | text      = So I tried to figure out where all these quotes exist in the order that he's reading them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:36.240
    | text      = And I figured out that he was just reading the introduction to the book The New World
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:39.279
    | text      = Order by A. Ralph Epperson.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:42.200
    | text      = Epperson was a classic New World Order and various other conspiracy theory crank.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:46.960
    | text      = And I think my favorite of his big claims is that Jesse James wasn't killed in 1882,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:52.319
    | text      = but instead lived on under a fake name and was elected Senator of Montana from 1901 to
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:57.400
    | text      = 1907.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:58.480
    | text      = That's the type of shit we gotta get back to.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:01.519
    | text      = That's where I wanna live.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:02.519
    | text      = I wanna live where a guy's just out of nowhere being like, and also, Jesse James is still
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:06.720
    | text      = alive.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:07.720
    | text      = That's what I'm here for.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:08.720
    | text      = So you see, Jordan, back in the day, there were a lot of these Wild West figures who
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:12.799
    | text      = were really famous, but no one really knew who they were.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:15.519
    | text      = A lot of people didn't have IDs, they used fake names and wanted phone cameras.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:20.539
    | text      = So there would be cool names like Jesse James and Billy the Kid.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:26.480
    | text      = People could just pretend to be that person after they had died.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:29.319
    | text      = Yeah, nobody's gonna stop you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:30.400
    | text      = It happened a lot, and it was actually the basis of the plot of Young Guns 2.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:35.079
    | text      = Was that the one with Charlie Sheen and Emilio Estevez?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:38.839
    | text      = Aren't they in both?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:40.440
    | text      = I don't know.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:41.440
    | text      = I mean, I think so.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:42.440
    | text      = The Young Guns franchise had the two of them in it?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:44.599
    | text      = I think so.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:45.599
    | text      = Alright.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:46.599
    | text      = Jon Bon Jovi.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Really?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:48.599
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:49.599

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = No.

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = Ooh, he should've.

{{TranscriptBlock

    | timestamp = 00:21:52.599
    | text      = He should've.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:53.599
    | text      = Yeah.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:54.599
    | text      = It was right there for him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = There was a lot of Japanese baseball players.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:57.920
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = That sounds right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:59.920
    | text      = Who joined the New World Order.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:00.920
    | text      = That sounds right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = But not Jon Bon Jovi.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:02.920
    | text      = Okay, fair enough.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:03.920
    | text      = So in 1948, a man named J. Frank Dalton appeared and claimed to be Jesse James.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:08.160
    | text      = Unfortunately he had also previously claimed to be a US Marshal named Frank Dalton, who
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:12.160
    | text      = he definitely wasn't.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:13.839
    | text      = And also that called into serious question if J. Frank Dalton was even his actual name.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:19.720
    | text      = He also spent a little bit of time pretending to be the head of a Confederate secret society
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:23.559
    | text      = called the Knights of the Golden Circle, which gave him access to tons of buried treasures.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:27.839
    | text      = Love it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:28.839
    | text      = In 1995, Jesse James' actual descendants had his grave exhumed and they did mitochondrial
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:33.559
    | text      = DNA testing, which found that the body that was buried there was consistent with their
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:37.680
    | text      = DNA, strongly concluding that that was the actual Jesse James.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:40.680
    | text      = Right, right, right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:41.680
    | text      = He's dead, yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:42.680
    | text      = Even if this guy was Jesse James, which he wasn't, Dalton was still like never a senator
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:47.319
    | text      = from Montana.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:49.119
    | text      = This is just one of the great examples of these old-time US fraudsters, and A. Ralph
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:53.519
    | text      = Epperson wrote a whole damn book about how correct this guy's claims were.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:58.640
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:59.640
    | text      = And he also wrote a book about the New World Order, which Bill is just plagiarizing here
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:02.440
    | text      = on the radio show, reading these various times people have said New World Order.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:06.920
    | text      = Those were the days.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:07.920
    | text      = Those were the days when you could just do whatever you want.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:11.200
    | text      = I mean, you say that it was like the Old West, but when you stop and think about what you
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = could do and how it was just whatever you want, that's crazy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:20.039
    | text      = That's crazy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:21.039
    | text      = Yeah, I was reading something about that, and apparently Jesse James and some of his
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = robberies and stuff, he would use disguises.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:28.799
    | text      = And so a lot of people really had no idea what he looked like.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:30.920
    | text      = Why would you?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:31.920
    | text      = That's the idea.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:32.920
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:33.920
    | text      = If you're a famous bank robber, you should not know what he looks like.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:36.839
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:37.839
    | text      = It's very simple.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:38.839
    | text      = Someone who had claimed to have met Jesse James said that this guy was Jesse James,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = and then he realized, well, actually, no.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:49.079
    | text      = He's at least the person that I was introduced to as Jesse James at some point.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:53.240
    | text      = To be clear, I am not reporting accurate information.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:57.079
    | text      = I'm reporting the information that I was given.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:59.079
    | text      = I only know that I met him 20 years ago as Jesse James, so if he's doing this, he's been
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:03.039
    | text      = doing it for a while.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:04.039
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:05.039
    | text      = No.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:06.039
    | text      = I mean, the power of a letter of recommendation back then, the power of a letter that you
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:11.079
    | text      = absolutely could have written yourself.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:13.119
    | text      = Yeah, that can't be fake.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:14.680
    | text      = Incredible.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:15.680
    | text      = Incredible.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:16.680
    | text      = So Hitler also said New World Order.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:18.839
    | text      = Sure, I bet he did.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:19.839
    | text      = Adolf Hitler, a socialist and the head of the German government prior to and during
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:24.799
    | text      = the nation's involvement in World War II, is quoted as saying this, quote, national
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:29.799
    | text      = socialism will use its own revolution for the establishing of a new world order, unquote.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:39.960
    | text      = Adolf Hitler was a socialist.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:41.680
    | text      = He means national socialism.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:45.920
    | text      = Hitler confided to Hermann Rauschning, the president of the Danzig Senate, quote, national
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:51.039
    | text      = socialism is more than a religion.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:52.880
    | text      = It is the will to create superman, unquote.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:56.440
    | text      = And what is the number of the man?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:00.119
    | text      = Six, six, six.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:03.319
    | text      = You see, in the New World Order, only one man will be allowed to live, the new man,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:07.160
    | text      = the illumined man.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:08.160
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:09.640
    | text      = The number of that man is 666.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:12.839
    | text      = You will see that number increasingly all around you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:15.960
    | text      = I've not seen the number 666 around me pretty much ever, with two exceptions.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:21.599
    | text      = The only places I've ever seen it are in art that's meant to freak people like Bill
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:25.660
    | text      = out and then when people like Bill freak out about said art.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:29.359
    | text      = I would say that 666 has almost zero impact on my life outside of that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:33.960
    | text      = I don't run into it everywhere.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:36.000
    | text      = Oh, sometimes you'll see it in, like, graffiti and you'll be like, ah, some child went 666.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:42.519
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:43.519
    | text      = And you're like, well, the reason they did that was because it freaks people like Bill
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = out.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:47.400
    | text      = There is no...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:48.400
    | text      = Maybe a slot machine or a lotto comes up 666.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:51.039
    | text      = Hey, that's, isn't that creepy?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:53.440
    | text      = It's not, but is it?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:54.839
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:55.839
    | text      = It plays a very small role in my life.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:57.519
    | text      = I'm not sure that that's a real Hitler quote, but even if it is, it's not surprising that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:01.200
    | text      = he would be talking about wanting a New World Order that's different from the old one.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:04.960
    | text      = That was kind of his big thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:05.960
    | text      = He was all about that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:06.960
    | text      = He wasn't a fan of the current one.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:08.279
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:09.279
    | text      = The quote about supermen is from Hermann Röschening, who left the Nazi party in 1934 and fled Germany
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:14.559
    | text      = in 1936.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:15.559
    | text      = In 1939, he published a book called Hitler Speaks, which has also been called The Voice
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:20.400
    | text      = of Destruction.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:21.819
    | text      = The book contains a lot of things alleged to have been said by Hitler, but many historians
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:25.619
    | text      = look on it with a bit of skepticism.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:28.680
    | text      = Some people who question the book's authenticity are straight up neo-Nazis and Holocaust deniers
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:32.839
    | text      = who are seeking to defend Hitler from looking as bad as he does in the text.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:36.519
    | text      = But other non-Nazi folks have also found some reason to think that some of the book at least
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:41.200
    | text      = is inauthentic.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:42.200
    | text      = Either way, in the text, Röschening says, quote, those who see a national socialism
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:47.279
    | text      = nothing more than a political movement know scarcely anything of it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:50.700
    | text      = It's more than a religion.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:51.700
    | text      = It is the will to create mankind anew.
}}

    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:14.079
    | text      = Did you hear me?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:15.079
    | text      = Rhodes Scholars?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:16.079
    | text      = Rhodes Scholars?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:17.079
    | text      = I've met a couple of Rhodes Scholars.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:18.079
    | text      = Did Dusty Rhodes ever join the New World Order?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:20.199
    | text      = No.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:21.199
    | text      = Incorrect.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:22.199
    | text      = God damn it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:23.199
    | text      = Yep, he was in the New World Order.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:24.199
    | text      = Another clue about what is in store for the future world was offered by Dr. James H. Billington.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:29.199
    | text      = Who received his doctorate as a Rhodes, Rhodes, Rhodes, Rhodes, Rhodes Scholar.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:34.440
    | text      = Where have you heard that before?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:36.159
    | text      = You have a Rhodes Scholar sitting in the Oval Office right now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:42.800
    | text      = Received his doctorate as a Rhodes Scholar at Oxford University and has taught at Harvard
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:46.639
    | text      = and Princeton Universities.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:48.000
    | text      = He wrote this in his book entitled, Fire in the Minds of Men.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:54.320
    | text      = This book seeks to trace the origins of a faith, perhaps the faith of our time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:00.679
    | text      = What is new is the belief that a perfect secular order will emerge from the forcible overthrow
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:06.159
    | text      = of traditional authority.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:08.840
    | text      = You hear that?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:09.840
    | text      = They believe a perfect secular order will emerge.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:14.000
    | text      = Nothing perfect will ever emerge from the minds of imperfect men.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:21.000
    | text      = This is from James Billington's book, Fire in the Minds of Men, Origins of the Revolutionary
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:26.199
    | text      = Faith.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:27.199
    | text      = Bill is reading from Epperson's book, which paraphrases the first lines of the introduction
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:31.800
    | text      = of Billington's.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:33.559
    | text      = In full, the original says, quote, this book seeks to trace the origins of a faith, perhaps
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:38.780
    | text      = the faith of our time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:40.440
    | text      = Modern revolutionaries are believers, no less committed and intense than were the Christians
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:44.679
    | text      = and Muslims of an earlier era.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:47.360
    | text      = What is new is the belief that a perfect secular society will emerge from the forcible overthrow
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:52.679
    | text      = of traditional authority.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:54.920
    | text      = Epperson's quoting of the passage removes the line about Christians and Muslims because
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:58.639
    | text      = he wanted to obscure the point that these revolutionaries Billington is writing about
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:02.920
    | text      = are not all that different from religious revolutionaries of the past, except in the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:07.719
    | text      = sense that they're secularly inclined.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:10.039
    | text      = And because of that editorial choice that Epperson made in terms of quoting this passage
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:15.199
    | text      = from Billington, now Bill is just reading.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:18.760
    | text      = Well because religious people are nothing like revolutionaries.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:24.639
    | text      = They're just doing regulararies for God.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:28.280
    | text      = And sure, it seems very similar, the things that they do and the results that they have
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:33.440
    | text      = on the lives of other people.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:35.519
    | text      = But one of them has God.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:37.760
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:38.760
    | text      = It's the people who are doing it for some sort of a religious reason.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:42.760
    | text      = They're doing it because that's upholding the natural order of things.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:46.800
    | text      = Whereas you are not great.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:49.719
    | text      = The most revolutionary.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:51.960
    | text      = So Bill goes on, keeps reading, and brings up old B.F. Skinner.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:57.320
    | text      = Hey, that's nice.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:58.559
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:59.559
    | text      = That's nice.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:00.559
    | text      = That these future changes would involve force and slavery was confirmed by B.F. Skinner,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:05.440
    | text      = chairman of the psychology department at Harvard University.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:08.000
    | text      = In his book entitled Beyond Freedom and Dignity, Dr. Skinner has been called the most influential
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:14.559
    | text      = of living American psychologists by Time magazine.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:17.519
    | text      = So the world should listen to the professor when he speaks.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:21.519
    | text      = The magazine told the reader what the message of Professor Skinner's book was.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:27.239
    | text      = We can no longer afford freedom, and so it must be replaced with control over man, his
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:31.559
    | text      = conduct and his culture.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:33.980
    | text      = So this is a 1971 book that B.F. Skinner wrote called Beyond Freedom and Dignity.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:39.940
    | text      = In the introduction he clearly lays out sort of the theme of what he's talking about.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:45.340
    | text      = The application of the physical and biological sciences alone will not solve our problems
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:50.099
    | text      = because the solutions lie in another field.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:52.940
    | text      = Better contraceptives will control population only if we use them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:56.519
    | text      = New weapons may offset new defenses and vice versa, but a nuclear holocaust can be prevented
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:00.980
    | text      = only if the conditions under which nations make war can be changed.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:05.420
    | text      = New methods of agriculture and medicine will not help people if they're not practiced,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:09.380
    | text      = and housing is a matter not only of buildings and cities, but of how people live.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:13.780
    | text      = Overcrowding can be corrected only by inducing people not to crowd, and the environment will
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:18.780
    | text      = continue to deteriorate until polluting practices are abandoned.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:22.619
    | text      = In short, we need to make vast changes in human behavior, and we cannot make them with
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:26.900
    | text      = the help of nothing more than physics and biology, no matter how hard we try.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:31.719
    | text      = So Skinner goes on to make the argument that our civilization has made essentially zero
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:35.420
    | text      = progress on understanding human behavior from the time of Plato to the 70s.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:40.900
    | text      = Greek philosophers in the realm of physics made a lot of breakthroughs, but also their
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:44.460
    | text      = findings are useless to us now, except as a matter of historical interest.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:49.139
    | text      = Conversely, modern science around behavior not really that much more advanced than what
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:53.500
    | text      = they were discussing in the old Greek texts.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:56.579
    | text      = He says, quote, whereas Greek physics and biology, no matter how crude, led eventually
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:00.900
    | text      = to modern science, Greek theories of human behavior led nowhere.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:05.659
    | text      = And I think he makes a great point, too, in the introduction where he's saying, he's talking
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:08.579
    | text      = about how, like, if you showed modern physics and all this shit to Greek thinkers of that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:14.940
    | text      = time, they'd have no idea what to do with any of that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:17.500
    | text      = But it's built upon what they had created.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:20.420
    | text      = Whereas, if you took human behavioral theories and you showed it to them, they would have
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:24.960
    | text      = no problem.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:26.139
    | text      = It would be right in line with a lot of the stuff that's in those, like, Socratic dialogues
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:29.659
    | text      = and shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:30.659
    | text      = Yeah, people don't understand themselves too well.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:33.739
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:34.739
    | text      = His basic point is that we have these concepts like, quote, states of mind, feelings, traits
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:39.179
    | text      = of character, human nature, and so on, that predominate the study of behavior.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:44.260
    | text      = These kinds of variables were once part of our understanding of physics and biology,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:48.059
    | text      = but we needed to let them go in order for those sciences to progress.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:51.539
    | text      = He's talking about how, like, back in the day Aristotle used to think that things sped
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:55.659
    | text      = up when they fell because they were eager to get to Earth.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:58.219
    | text      = They loved the Earth!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:59.219
    | text      = That kind of personification is something that existed in some of the past of sciences.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:04.340
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:05.340
    | text      = Skinner is arguing that as long as these ideas, including the illusion of freedom and dignity,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:10.099
    | text      = persist, no one will pursue a true science of behavior, which is something that he's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:14.260
    | text      = into.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:15.260
    | text      = And I can understand if you're not into the science of behavior and you're not into B.F.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:19.780
    | text      = Skinner, totally understand.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:21.139
    | text      = Well...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:22.139
    | text      = I think Bill's misrepresenting it a little bit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:24.619
    | text      = Sure, sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:25.619
    | text      = But I also am certain that Bill has never read that book.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = Order book.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:37.800
    | text      = So this is just third-hand at best.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:41.579

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = Holy shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = I do not think we're going to find a lot of...

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = It's not as bad as it could be, but it's still pretty glaring.

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:49:23.579

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:49:39.260
    | text      = My point here is that Bill is a fraud, and in that clip there you can see it clearly.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Having sources and texts to make a larger point is good, but that is not what Bill is

{{TranscriptBlock

    | timestamp = 00:49:48.699
    | text      = doing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:49:49.699
    | text      = He is taking ownership over this text that he had no part in creating.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:49:55.099
    | text      = And it's bad.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:34.460

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:35.460

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:46.019

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:28.019
    | text      = So there's more instances of this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:29.019
    | text      = This is what I would describe as malicious plagiarism.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = There are numerous works by other writers, lecturers, researchers exposing the involvement

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:39.559

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:44.400

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:49.159
    | text      = And so here is just a prime example of that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:51.800
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:52.800
    | text      = The initiate into the Blue Lodge goes through three separate and different initiation ceremonies.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:57.780
    | text      = One for each degree.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:59.340
    | text      = After completing these ceremonies, he may stay where he is or choose to affiliate himself
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:03.920
    | text      = with either the York Rite, which has thirteen degrees, or the Scottish Rite, which has thirty-two,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:08.960
    | text      = and then the Meritorious Thirty-Third.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:11.280
    | text      = The latter is divided into two separate jurisdictions, the Southern and the Northern.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:16.039
    | text      = And these are based primarily on state borders, and whether one joins one or the other depends
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:21.159
    | text      = on where the initiate lives.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:24.079
    | text      = The two Scottish Rites have an additional twenty-nine degrees, making for a total of
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:28.840
    | text      = thirty-two.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:30.420
    | text      = There is one more degree called the Thirty-Third Degree, which is honorary, and only a few
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:34.219
    | text      = are invited into that degree, and to even be considered, they must perform some major
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:40.219
    | text      = work toward the completion of the Great Work, which is the plan to bring about.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:46.619
    | text      = Turning lead into gold?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:47.619
    | text      = The socialist dream.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:52.619
    | text      = York Rite has a total of nine degrees.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:54.820
    | text      = However, since little has been revealed about this order, we will concentrate on only the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:59:00.099
    | text      = Scottish Rite, and in particular the Southern Jurisdiction.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:59:03.139
    | text      = Well, I've since discovered that the York Rite has a total of thirteen degrees, folks.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:59:08.099
    | text      = Thanks.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:59:09.099
    | text      = Not just nine.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:59:10.099
    | text      = So, toward the beginning of that clip, Bill says that there are thirteen levels in the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:59:13.739
    | text      = York Rite, which was him riffing away from the text a little bit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:59:17.940
    | text      = He continued reading, not knowing that Epperson later says that the York Rite has nine degrees,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:59:22.340
    | text      = which contradicts what Bill just said.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:59:24.539
    | text      = So Bill has to try to correct the ship by saying that he's since learned that the York
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:59:28.539
    | text      = Rite has thirteen degrees, not nine, which is meant to imply that since the time Bill
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:59:36.679
    | text      = It feels very weird.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:59:38.559
    | text      = It is so amazing how quickly he discovered that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:59:42.619
    | text      = He went from not knowing it to knowing it was wrong to then rediscovering that actually
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = he was right the entire time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Fascinating.

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
